svg.title: Upload and download
svg.desc: Two prompts. Upload, share your lessons: paste the prompt, it sorts your rules into universal, project-only and dead, you say yes, the lessons are sent. Download, get the honey: it backs up your file, brings the new AGENTS.md, keeps your project block, and writes only after you say yes. Nothing is sent or overwritten without your yes.
